column1: # Vendored from the ACM replication archive mirrored at https://github.com/dmitry-of-oz/acm
# to the last trading day of each month
# Zero-coupon yield at maturity n months (annualized percent
#   y(n) = BETA0 + BETA1*g1 + BETA2*(g1 - e1) + BETA3*(g2 - e2)
#   rows with TAU2 = 0 carry BETA3 = 0 (plain Nelson-Siegel dates): treat the BETA3 term as 0.
# Caveat: the 1- and 2-month yields are model extrapolations (GSW fit securities with >= 3
# months to maturity); pre-1982 they are noisy — ACM's production code splices the effective
# federal funds rate there. The tsecon fixtures run on the raw GSW curve and document the
# resulting (small) difference against the published ACM series.
